title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a colour-blind-safe palette to the Session 3 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 trajectory uses blue for stage 1 and green for stage 2; some colour-blind users cannot tell them apart.

## Context
Accessibility is part of the quality checklist (QUALITY.md, item 9).

## Expected outcome
Colours plus line styles (for example solid and dashed) that keep the two stages distinguishable in light and dark mode.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both stages distinguishable in grayscale
- [ ] Screenshot added to the pull request

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: launch from a rotating Earth
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask why launch sites such as Sriharikota are near the coast and fly east.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: thrust that changes with altitude
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses constant thrust and Isp; real engines lose thrust at sea level because of the outside pressure.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app where the exit area is a slider and the lift-off thrust and Isp follow the outside pressure.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The roadmap checkpoint is met and shown in a figure
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: an animated two-stage flight to orbit
body:
## Problem
The Target is an animated flight from a rotating Earth with throttling, staging and an optimised steering law; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target description.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `promo/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A 200 km orbit (perigee above 190 km) with a closed delta-v budget
- [ ] Short write-up of your method and the payload you reach

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Show the pitch angle and flight-path angle in the Session 3 app
body:
## Problem
The Session 3 app shows where the rocket goes but not where it points. Students cannot see the gravity turn happen.

## Context
The difference between the thrust direction and the velocity direction is the steering loss of Section B.

## Expected outcome
A new graph button that plots the pitch angle and the flight-path angle against time, with labelled axes and units.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/app.html`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Both angles plotted in degrees against time
- [ ] Works in light and dark mode

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
